## Overview Passes the OpenAI `response_format` through the Mistral renderer into mistral-common chat templating: mistral-common 1.13 renders the requested output format into the v15 `[MODEL_SETTINGS]` block alongside `reasoning_effort`. Also accepts `response_format` on `/tokenize` so the rendered prompt can be inspected. Not a duplicate: searched open PRs/issues for `response_format` + Mistral; the open items are structured-output bugs on other backends (e.g. #62483, #49095) and none forward `response_format` into the Mistral tokenizer's chat template. ## Claims - The OpenAI `response_format` is converted to its mistral-common equivalent in the Mistral renderer and forwarded to the tokenizer. - Only applied for v15+ tokenizers, so requests without it and older tokenizers render exactly as before. - `response_format` is accepted on `/tokenize` for rendered-prompt inspection. ## Validation - `python -m pytest tests/renderers/test_mistral.py tests/tokenizers_/test_mistral.py tests/entrypoints/serve/tokenize/test_serving_tokenization.py -v` — extended by this change and wired into CI. - Requires mistral-common >= 1.13 for the format to reach the template; the forwarding is inert with older versions (same rendering as before). ## Details - The conversion happens in the renderer (not the protocol layer) so the OpenAI-facing surface stays unchanged; the tokenizer only sees the mistral-common format. - The `/tokenize` extension uses the same conversion, which makes the exact rendered prompt verifiable without a chat completion.

nodes.body: Thanks for the review @sfeng33 ! We're actually going with @juliendenize PR as I didn't realize he was working on the same thing. @juliendenize could you make sure we address Flora's review on the other PR?

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

`MistralResponseFormats.json` is the 1.11/1.12 name. On mistral-common main the enum is `text`, `json_object`, `json_schema`. So on the only version where line 14 imports, a `json_object` request hits AttributeError here and returns a 500. The tests use the same name. `MistralResponseFormats("json_object")` works on both.

+

nodes.body: This runs the `MistralJsonSchema` validator (Draft-7 `check_schema`) outside the try in `safe_apply_chat_template` and, in the async path, on the event loop. A bad schema like `{"type": 123}` comes back as a raw pydantic error instead of the normalized mistral-common one, and a large schema blocks the loop. Can this move inside the executor call so it runs with the rest of the rendering?
nodes.diffHunk:
@@ -47,6 +49,12 @@ def safe_apply_chat_template(
         raise ValueError(str(e)) from e
 
 
+def _get_chat_template_kwargs(params: ChatParams) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    kwargs = params.get_apply_chat_template_kwargs()
+    kwargs["response_format"] = to_mistral_response_format(params.response_format)

nodes.body: Chat runs `validate_response_format` on this field, tokenize does not. So `{"type": "json_schema"}` with no schema is a 400 on chat but a 200 here with no `[MODEL_SETTINGS]` block. That makes /tokenize show a different prompt than chat would send. Can we reuse the chat validator here?

`JsonSchema` and `ResponseFormats.json_schema` only exist on mistral-common main. The latest release is 1.12.0 and does not have them, so with our `>= 1.11.6` pin this module fails to import and every Mistral, Pixtral and Voxtral model stops loading. Is the plan to wait for a mistral-common release and bump the pin in this PR first?

So `{"type": "json_schema"}` with no schema is a 400 on chat but a 200 here with no `[MODEL_SETTINGS]` block. That makes /tokenize show a different prompt than chat would send. Can we reuse the chat validator here?

`JsonSchema` and `ResponseFormats.json_schema` only exist on mistral-common main. The latest release is 1.12.0 and does not have them, so with our `>= 1.11.6` pin this module fails to import and every Mistral, Pixtral and Voxtral model stops loading. Is the plan to wait for a mistral-common release and bump the pin in this PR first?
